review_evidence: README explicitly advertises JSON Schema types, total validation, soundness/completeness theorems, bridge theorems, and ValidatesAgainstSchema derivation support.
JsonSchema/Correctness/Soundness.lean and Completeness.lean prove validation properties for null/string/boolean/number/array/object/tuple/oneOf schemas.
JsonSchema/Correctness/ValidatesAgainstSchema.lean defines a Prop-valued correctness class asserting validateJson schema (toJson a) = .ok () for every value and proves base/collection instances.
summary: Retain lean4-json-schema: it contains explicit soundness, completeness, serialization, bridge, and end-to-end validation correctness proofs.
